name: Anant Raj Cloud Manesar Data Center
developer: Anant Raj Cloud / Anant Raj Limited
notes: Anant Raj Cloud's flagship Haryana data centre at Plot No. 1, Sector 8, Tower C, IMT Manesar, Gurugram district; commissioned September 2023 and scaled from 6 MW to ~21 MW IT load (part of 28 MW operational across Manesar and Panchkula per ETDatacenters/Convergence Now). TIA-942 certified (EPI/TIA Online listing). 21 MW capacity figure from Data Center Map and Baxtel listings; company-reported state-wide target is 307 MW by FY32.

name: Anant Raj Cloud Haryana Expansion (Manesar-led 307 MW roadmap)
developer: Anant Raj Cloud / Anant Raj Limited
notes: Anant Raj signed an MoU with the Government of Haryana (via HSIIDC/HEPC) in July 2025 to invest ~Rs 20,000 crore and raise its Haryana data centre capacity to ~307 MW by FY2032 across Manesar (Gurugram district), Panchkula and Rai (Sonipat). Per-site capacity split not disclosed; the Manesar campus is the largest of the three sites and continues expanding. Separate planned entries for Panchkula and Rai are covered in batch-302/303; this line captures the Gurugram-district expansion component.

name: Nxtra Manesar I Data Center
developer: Nxtra Data Limited (Nxtra by Airtel / Bharti Airtel)
notes: Nxtra by Airtel (Bharti Airtel's data centre arm, headquartered in Gurugram) operates the Nxtra Manesar I facility at CP-05, Sector 8, IMT Manesar, Gurugram district. Data Center Map lists 8.5 MW capacity; colocation directories (Ocolo, Upstack marketplace) confirm the facility and address. Capacity figure from Data Center Map.

name: Gurugram Municipal Corporation Micro Data Centre
notes: Public-sector micro data centre announced January 2026 to act as the central control hub for Gurugram's water supply network (SCADA-style operations). Not a commercial colocation facility; no capacity disclosed. Included for completeness of Gurugram data centre activity.

name: BSNL Faridabad Datacenter Phase I
developer: BSNL (Bharat Sanchar Nigam Limited) / Dimension Data alliance
notes: BSNL's national data centre in Faridabad, Haryana, developed under the BSNL-Dimension Data strategic alliance for data centre services in India. Phase I of the Faridabad Datacenter carries an Uptime Institute Tier programme client listing (certification implies the facility was built and commissioned). No public MW capacity disclosed; status inferred as operational from certification record.
